desc: Implement interval DP with dp[l][r] = max score for subarray from index l to r (inclusive)
Handle base cases: single elements (score 0) and adjacent pairs (score |A[l] - A[r]|)
For each interval [l,r] with even length, compute max of: (1) pairing l and r directly if (r-l+1) is even, plus dp[l+1][r-1], or (2) splitting at any even position k: dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r]
Optimize by only considering intervals of even length (odd-length intervals cannot be fully removed)
Use bottom-up DP filling by increasing interval length, storing results in 2D array
Add fast I/O handling for N up to 3×10^5 and ensure O(N²) complexity is acceptable
Test with small cases to verify correctness of parity conditions
Profile and optimize constant factors for Python implementation (use arrays, avoid recursion)
Implement the O(N²) DP solution by removing the redundant split loop and optimizing the pairing transition
Investigate if a greedy or stack-based approach can solve the problem in O(N) or O(N log N) time.
Verify the correctness of the current O(N²) DP on the provided samples and edge cases (e.g., all equal elements, strictly increasing/decreasing sequences).
Analyze the structure of the optimal matching to find a more efficient algorithm.
